data.text/markdown:
Workplace well-being — Summary for Leadership

All subthemes under Workplace well-being declined between 2022 and 2024. The steepest drop was in A psychologically healthy workplace (-4.7 points), and the lowest-scoring subtheme in 2024 is Work-related stress (50.5 / 100).

Largest declines (2022→2024)

  • A psychologically healthy workplace: -4.7 points (2022→2024)
  • Work-related stress: -3.5 points (2022→2024)

What this means

Scores represent the percentage of respondents giving a positive or neutral response, expressed on a 0–100 scale. A decline of -4.7 points in a single survey cycle — with ~186,000 respondents — is both statistically significant and operationally meaningful.
Note: Statistical significance is expected at this sample size. Use the magnitude of change, not the p-value, as the primary indicator of policy relevance.
